method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Nasdaq slides 2% Friday to post worst week since June, pressured by AI sell-off and oil prices
Equities.reason: Direct market-moving headline: Nasdaq and AI-led tech names are the epicenter of the risk-off move. This reinforces a dominant negative equity narrative (AI derating, growth-to-value rotation) and has broad index spillovers — high relevance and strongly negative direction.

Equities.title: Chinese Stocks Turn Biggest Losers as Global AI Trade Stumbles
Equities.reason: Shows the AI-led selloff is global and hitting major regional equity markets (China). Reinforces market regime of AI de-risking and cross-border equity weakness — material for risk sentiment and EM/APAC equity flows.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Suffers Worst Week Since June as AI Fears Hit Chipmakers
Equities.reason: Broad index pain tied to AI concerns and chipmakers — a central equity-market narrative. High relevance because S&P performance reflects broad risk sentiment and potential earnings/valuation repricing.

Equities.title: Chip Stocks Post Longest Losing Streak Since 2008: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Chip sector is a bellwether for AI hardware demand and market leadership. An extended losing streak amplifies downside risk for tech indices and validates a broader risk-off equity regime.

Equities.title: Why CoreWeave is in the crosshairs of the AI scare
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic-but-systemic: CoreWeave's problems are a concrete catalyst for the AI selloff, hitting neocloud/compute plays and investor confidence in AI growth narratives. Moderate-high relevance as a sector-specific trigger.

Equities.title: The Austin Powers steamroller: How to trade CoreWeave's slow moving crisis
Equities.summary: After a 27.5% drop from last Friday's close to this Thursday morning's 52-week lows, followed by a 17% rebound, equity traders holding CoreWeave are dazed.
Equities.reason: Trading-focused piece that highlights volatility and contagion within AI/cloud names. Relevant as market microstructure and flow-driven risk that amplifies broader tech weakness; somewhat lower relevance than multi-market headlines.

Equities.title: Why Tech’s AI Borrowing Binge Is Rattling Markets
Equities.reason: Highlights leverage and funding risks underpinning the AI trade. This amplifies downside risk for equities if credit strains spread — meaningful for market regime and risk-premium repricing.

Equities.title: Weak Links Start to Show in A.I. Borrowing
Equities.reason: Confirms credit/financing stress in parts of the AI ecosystem — a negative signal for speculative growth names but more of a confirmatory piece with moderate relevance.

Equities.title: New Cracks in AI Trade Push Wall Street to Worst Week Since June
Equities.reason: WSJ framing of AI trade deterioration as a driver of broad market weakness. High relevance because it synthesizes the theme that pushed major indices lower over the week.

Equities.title: Equity Trading Gives Banks a Bright Spot This Earnings Season
Equities.reason: Sector-specific positive: trading revenues could offset weakness elsewhere in bank earnings. Relevant as a partial offset to broader equity stress but lower overall market impact.

Equities.title: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo puts the company's status-symbol power to the test
Equities.summary: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo is drawing early demand as analysts assess whether the foldable can lift iPhone pricing and revenue.
Equities.reason: Positive company-level news for a mega-cap that can influence index performance. Useful as a moderating signal against broad tech weakness but limited to Apple/cap-weight concentration effects.

Equities.title: I watched Nvidia's Jensen Huang work the room in London. He brought big checks — and a blunt message
Equities.summary: Nvidia has a near monopoly over the most powerful AI chips and Huang courts tech execs and world leaders with ease.
Equities.reason: Reinforces the enduring leadership/market-power narrative for Nvidia and AI incumbents. Even amid a broader selloff, leadership concentration can support selective market resilience — medium relevance.

Rates.title: Fed: Higher yields keep tightening path intact – Nordea
Rates.summary: Nordea’s research team keeps its Federal Reserve outlook unchanged, expecting one more rate hike this year and another in 2027 as US inflation remains above the 2% target and growth stays strong.
Rates.reason: Nordea expects additional Fed hikes and cites persistent inflation and strong growth — a clear higher-for-longer signal that keeps upward pressure on US yields (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening
Rates.summary: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.
Rates.reason: Warsh's withholding of an explicit hike signal is partly offset by his praise of global synchronous tightening — overall tilts toward continued restrictive policy and upside pressure on yields.

Rates.title: BoJ's Ueda signals further rate hikes as underlying inflation nears 2%
Rates.summary: Bank of Japan (BoJ) Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated on Friday that the central bank will continue raising interest rates as underlying inflation approaches its 2% target, noting that financial conditions remain accommodative.
Rates.reason: BoJ signalling continued hikes shifts the JGB and global rates narrative toward tightening; this is meaningful for bond markets given BoJ's previous easing stance.

Rates.title: Ueda ‘Can’t Tolerate’ Underlying Inflation Further Over 2%
Rates.reason: Bloomberg's stronger framing of Ueda's intolerance for inflation >2% underscores a hawkish BoJ tilt — likely to accelerate JGB tightening and feed into global yield repricing.

Rates.title: BOJ may need to tighten faster if inflation beats forecast, IMF says
Rates.reason: IMF warning that BOJ may need faster tightening reinforces expectations of steeper JGB yield moves and contributes to a global higher-for-longer rates narrative.

Rates.title: Mortgage Bond Sales Put on Hold as Investors Demand More Yield
Rates.reason: Primary mortgage issuance being paused because investors demand higher yields is a direct market signal that risk-free and agency spread levels have risen — negative for fixed-income supply clearing.

Rates.title: Long-Term Treasuries Fall as Dealer Survey Offers Little Signal
Rates.reason: Reported falls in long-term Treasuries point to higher long-end yields; dealer survey ambiguity suggests limited immediate liquidity relief, reinforcing a selloff narrative.

Rates.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
Rates.summary: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.
Rates.reason: Large fiscal deficits combined with elevated Treasury yields imply structural upward pressure on funding costs and sustained higher nominal yields — negative for bond prices and an important macro driver.

Rates.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
Rates.summary: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.
Rates.reason: A near-$2tn deficit increases expected Treasury issuance and refinancing needs, adding supply-side pressure that supports higher yields — a material negative for bond markets.

Rates.title: Investors Prepare for Data Dump That Will Determine Canada’s Rate Path
Rates.reason: Headline flags upcoming data that could move expectations for the Bank of Canada — relevant to Canadian yields. With the prevailing global tightening narrative, assign a mild tilt toward higher yields until data proves otherwise.

Rates.title: Bank of America Taps High-Grade Bond Market After Turbulent Week
Rates.reason: An issuer accessing the high-grade bond market after a turbulent week indicates tolerance for prevailing yields but also reflects that borrowers still face a higher-yield environment; near-term pressure on spreads/yields remains.

FX.summary: Scotiabank analysts highlight that Bank of England Governor Bailey sees little evidence of second-round inflation effects and a more resilient UK economy, with markets still pricing a 25bp hike next month.
FX.reason: Institutional FX view reinforcing GBP/USD upside on BoE-hike pricing and resilient UK growth — supports broader GBP-strength narrative versus USD.

FX.reason: CAD strength vs USD tied to firmer BoC rate expectations and narrowing US–Canada spreads — USD-centric, cross-border yields story with direct USD/CAD impact.

FX.summary: EUR/USD extends its recovery on Friday, trading around 1.1255 at the time of writing, up 0.32% on the day. The Euro (EUR) continues to strengthen against the US Dollar (USD), rebounding from a 16-month low of 1.1113 reached on Wednesday.

FX.reason: Institutional confirmation that EUR/USD strength is driven by narrowing front-end spreads and dovish-leaning Fed comments — reinforces broader USD-weakness/euro-support theme.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Recovery contrasts with domestic imbalances – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale highlights that the Chinese Yuan (CNY) is trading at its strongest level since 2022, despite IMF estimates suggesting it remains significantly undervalued.
FX.reason: CNY trading at multi-year strength vs USD — FX-native institutional note signalling EM/China FX resilience within the broader USD-softness backdrop.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI defence limits losses against US Dollar - DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao reviews the Reserve Bank of India’s multi-layered strategy to support the Rupee in 2026.
FX.reason: RBI intervention/defensive measures limiting INR weakness vs USD — central-bank FX defence story with direct USD/INR implications, moderate relevance.

FX.title: Taiwan Dollar: Foreign outflows pressure currency – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that Taiwan Dollar (TWD) has extended losses on heavy foreign equity outflows, partly retracing into the Asian close amid talk of CBC leaning against depreciation.
FX.reason: TWD depreciation on foreign equity outflows and talk of central bank leaning against depreciation — a localized EM/Asia funding flow story that acts as a counter-signal to broader USD-softness.

FX.title: Brazilian Real: Election-driven support with downside risks – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Norman Liebke at Commerzbank highlights that Brazil’s presidential run-off on 25 October between Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro is closely watched by markets. A Bolsonaro victory would likely bring more market-friendly, fiscally conservative policies and c
FX.reason: EMFX view: election outcomes could materially affect BRL vs USD; relevant for EM-risk and currency flows but lower immediate relevance to G10 USD narrative.

Commodities.title: Brent oil touches $110 as Iran escalates Hormuz attacks, Ukraine vows to hit Russian refineries
Commodities.summary: U.S. crude oil prices rose sharply Friday as Iran escalated attacks in the Strait of Hormuz this week.
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz raises near-term supply-risk premium for crude, lifting prices. Strong market-moving oil-risk narrative (Iran/Maritime attacks) supports a bullish oil impulse with high relevance for commodities.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil Taps $110 for First Time Since May as Risks Swirl
Commodities.reason: Headline indicates renewed oil supply-risk and higher price regime. Reinforces dominant bullish oil narrative driven by geopolitical and supply-side concerns; medium-high relevance as a market-moving macro commodity story.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Hurricane threat to Gulf Coast production and infrastructure raises the risk of crude and refined-product shut-ins, a direct supply-side positive for oil and gasoline prices. High relevance for energy commodity risk premia.

Commodities.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
Commodities.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year f
Commodities.reason: EIA expects lower natural gas and propane prices to reduce winter energy expenditures in parts of the U.S. That outlook is directly negative for natural gas/propane commodity prices and consumption-driven price support.

Commodities.title: Canada: Energy-driven resilience with limited core pass-through – RBC
Commodities.summary: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) strategis Claire Fan and Abbey Xu expect Canada’s headline Consumer Price Index to remain at 3% year-over-year in September, supported by higher gasoline and furnace Oil prices.
Commodities.reason: RBC ties higher gasoline and furnace oil prices to headline CPI resilience in Canada. This supports demand-side price persistence for refined products and crude — modestly positive for energy commodities with medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Canada: Oil windfall boosts income but widens regional divides - RBC
Commodities.summary: Royal Bank of Canada’s (RBC) Nathan Janzen analyzes how higher Oil prices are boosting Canada’s real gross domestic income much faster than GDP, largely via export revenues.
Commodities.reason: Higher oil prices materially boosting national income highlights stronger crude price environment and export-driven demand effects — a constructive fundamental signal for oil markets with clear relevance to commodity flows.

Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) price retreats about 0.10%, trading at $4,163 on Friday, poised for a weekly loss as traders assess recent US inflation data, which, although hotter than foreseen, led investors to trim their hawkish bets for the Federal Open Market Committee (F
Commodities.reason: Rising US Treasury yields and changing Fed-hike expectations increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold, exerting downward pressure on prices. Rates-driven narrative is a dominant negative for bullion.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles for direction as Fed rate-hike bets keep buyers cautious
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) holds modest gains on Friday as a softer US Dollar (USD) and lower Treasury yields lend support. However, hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) expectations keep buyers cautious about chasing prices aggressively higher.
Commodities.reason: Mixed forces (softer USD/lower yields provide support while Fed hawkishness caps upside) leave gold directionless; overall bias is modestly negative given prevailing rate-sensitivity and cautious buyer behaviour.

Commodities.reason: Technical breakdown and bearish momentum (RSI/price below key support) point to near-term downside risk for silver. As a price-forecast/technical piece, relevance is capped.

Commodities.title: Peru Indigenous Group Bids for Part of China-Owned Copper Mine
Commodities.reason: Local bids and ownership challenges can introduce operational and permitting risk at a major copper asset, tightening near-term supply prospects. Supply-side political/ownership risk is constructive for copper prices.

Commodities.title: Congo Arrests Hundreds of Chinese Miners in Copper Heartland
Commodities.reason: Large-scale arrests in a copper-producing region risk near-term output disruptions and greater geopolitical/operational uncertainty for supply. This is a significant supply-side bullish signal for copper with above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: India Halts Sugar Diversion to Ethanol After El Nino Hurts Crops
Commodities.reason: El Nino-related crop damage reduces sugar production; policy to halt diversion to ethanol appears aimed at conserving domestic sugar supply. Net effect is a tightening supply narrative for sugar, supporting prices with medium relevance.
